About Us

An Independent Garage, Not A Franchise Chain

We are a local garage on Dishley Street in Leominster, looking after cars, vans and camper vans for people across Herefordshire and the Welsh Marches. Mark has spent 35 years working on vehicles in and around Leominster, and you speak to the person who will actually be working on yours.

Nothing gets done to your vehicle until we have rung you, explained what we have found and you have said yes to it.

Common Questions

FAQ

Yes. We are a DVSA approved Class 4 test centre, so cars, small vans and camper vans up to 3,000kg are tested here at Market Mill Garage. If anything fails, the work can be done in the same workshop rather than sending you somewhere else.

All of them. Petrol, diesel and hybrid, cars, vans and camper vans, whatever the badge on the bonnet. Servicing here does not affect a manufacturer warranty as long as the correct parts and schedule are used, and that is what we do.

Always. If we find something beyond what you booked in for, we ring you, explain what it is and what it will cost, and wait for you to say yes. You will never pick your vehicle up and find a bill you did not agree to.

Bring it in and we will read the fault codes. A code tells us where to look, not what to replace, so we test from there to find the actual cause. You get told what is wrong and what the fix involves before any work starts.

We do. Mark is an IMI qualified repair centre for electric vehicles, so EVs and hybrids can be serviced and repaired here rather than going back to a main dealer. Ring us with the make and model and we will confirm what we can cover.

Yes, camper vans and motorhomes on a Class 4 base are welcome for MOTs, servicing and repairs. Give us a ring with the make and weight and we will confirm it fits on the ramp before you drive over.
